Route 6 – Pokémon & Locations

Q&A

9 species. Most common: Psyduck (100 %), Magikarp (100 %), Poliwag (60 %). The rarest catch is Gyarados (15 %). All rates are the max encounter slots from PokéAPI (FireRed).

Yes, there are differences. The versions differ on Route 6 like this: Oddish only in FireRed (25%); Psyduck only in FireRed (100%); Bellsprout only in LeafGreen (25%); Slowpoke only in LeafGreen (100%)

Yes. You can find 2 items on Route 6: Sitrus Berry, Rare Candy.
